title: 5.111SC Principles of Chemical Science
description: Introductory university chemistry in five units and 35 lectures: the atom (quantum description, hydrogen and multi-electron atoms), chemical bonding and structure, thermodynamics and chemical equilibrium (including acid–base), transition metals and oxidation–reduction, and chemical kinetics. Each lecture page carries a video, fill-in lecture notes, clicker questions, a textbook reading assignment and problems with solutions.
rightsNotes: Content is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by MIT OpenCourseWare (footer licence link on every page opened 2026-10-30); attribution and share-alike are required and commercial use is excluded. Corniversity is private and non-commercial.

Some figures inside the lecture-notes PDFs are marked '© sources unknown. All rights reserved. This content is excluded from our Creative Commons license' (seen in lecture 8 notes, PDF page 2); Corniversity cites pages and does not reproduce figures.

The lecture notes are fill-in summaries written for live lectures: blanks are left for values and words supplied in class, so extracted text has gaps. They are cited for structure and statements, never quoted as complete.
The assigned textbook (Atkins and Jones, Chemical Principles, 5th ed.) is commercial and is not required by Corniversity; the OpenStax Chemistry 2e web sections are used as the reading text instead.
The course's problem sets and solutions are linked, not copied; every Corniversity exercise is original and says so.
